short: The first black president, elected in the middle of a financial collapse.
full:
Obama took office with the economy shedding around 700,000 jobs a month. An $831 billion stimulus, the rescue of General Motors and Chrysler, and the Dodd-Frank regulation of 2010 stabilised it; unemployment fell from a peak of 10 per cent to under 5 by the end of his second term.

The Affordable Care Act, signed in March 2010 without a single Republican vote, extended insurance to roughly twenty million people and survived two Supreme Court challenges. He ordered the raid that killed Osama bin Laden in May 2011, wound down the war in Iraq, and negotiated the Iran nuclear agreement and the Paris climate accord in 2015. Republicans took the House in 2010 and the Senate in 2014, and much of his second term ran through executive action, including deportation relief for people brought to the country as children.
